subject: general
question:
Select the word that is opposite in meaning (ANTONYM) to the word given below

Polarize
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Combine'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Polarize"** is a verb which means to divide or cause to divide into two sharply contrasting groups or sets of opinions or beliefs. In Hindi, "polarize" translates to "ध्रुवीकरण करना" (dhruveekaran karna).
 
• The word that is opposite in meaning (antonym) to "polarize" among the provided options is "Combine".
 
• **"Combine"** means to unite or join together, which is the opposite of dividing or causing a division as "polarize" suggests. In Hindi, "combine" translates to "मिलाना" (milana).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let's look at the other options:

 
• **"Orchestrate" **means to arrange or direct the elements of a situation to produce a desired effect. It does not provide an opposite meaning to "polarize". In Hindi, "orchestrate" translates to "संगठित करना" (sangathit karna).
 
• **"Conjoin"** is similar to "combine" as it also means to join or merge, but it's usually used in the context of joining elements that are already closely related. In Hindi, "conjoin" translates to "जोड़ना" (jodna).
 
• **"Segregate" **means to set apart from the rest or from each other, or to isolate. It is closer in meaning to "polarize", not opposite. In Hindi, "segregate" translates to "अलग करना" (alag karna).
